elements.scope_reason: The single red-box criterion. Four parts: (1) no stools in the past 24 hours, (2) no flatus/wind in the past 24 hours, (3) abdominal pain, (4) abdominal distension; pain/distension is 'or'.

parts.part: No stools in the past 24 hours
parts.note: Obstipation (disorder; child of Constipation) with onset >= 24 hours ago. 'Obstipation' is the SNOMED term for complete absence of stool; no closer finding exists (no 'absolute constipation' / 'no bowel movement' concept).

parts.part: No flatus/wind in the past 24 hours
parts.note: Unable to break wind (finding; child of Finding of flatus) with onset >= 24 hours ago. Closest available concept.

parts.part: Abdominal pain
parts.note: Abdominal pain (finding), inside an 'or' with distension.

parts.part: Abdominal distension
Combination 'No stools or flatus'
parts.note: Encoded as AND (no stools AND no flatus). The literal reading of 'no stools or flatus' is 'neither' (absolute constipation), so AND is defensible; see rule_level_problems for the under-trigger risk.

evidence: Urgent: constipation with no stools or flatus for 24 hours :: (>= (onset (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Obstipation" "disorder"))) (time_ago 24 hours))
Urgent: constipation with no stools or flatus for 24 hours :: (>= (onset (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Unable to break wind" "finding"))) (time_ago 24 hours))

These are management and referral decisions, not triage or diagnosis; no manage tasks by design. rule_level_problems.rule: Check for colorectal cancer symptoms in constipation / Diagnose possible colorectal cancer in constipation
rule_level_problems.problem: The page's 'increased risk of colorectal cancer' criterion (previous colorectal cancer, polyps, ulcerative colitis, Crohn's; family history of colorectal cancer, multiple polyps, Lynch syndrome) is not encoded anywhere, though every item has a SNOMED concept (History of malignant neoplasm of cecum and/or colon and/or rectum; Polyp of colon; Ulcerative colitis; Crohn's disease; Family history of colorectal cancer; Lynch syndrome; Family history of genetic mutation for Lynch syndrome). The house standard expects the check_for to include every discriminating finding the page uses and the possible rule to follow the page's logic. The '> 50 years' gate is not representable (age bands only) and should be documented.

rule_level_problems.rule: Urgent: constipation with no stools or flatus for 24 hours
rule_level_problems.problem: 'No stools or flatus/wind in the past 24 hours' is encoded as an AND of two separately recorded findings (Obstipation AND Unable to break wind), each with its own onset >= 24 hours. The literal reading supports AND, but in practice a health worker who records only 'no stools for 24 hours' plus abdominal pain will not trigger Urgent, and the house pattern for red boxes is '(and <complaint> (or ...items...))'. Reasonable to change to OR, or at minimum to record the choice as a decision for a clinician.

rule_level_problems.rule: Check for colorectal cancer symptoms in constipation
rule_level_problems.problem: 'Change in bowel habits like constipation, diarrhoea, or change in stool consistency' is reduced to Diarrhea. 'Altered bowel function' (finding) and 'Change in stool consistency' (finding) exist; the latter is missing outright.

rule_level_problems.rule: Check for faecal impaction in constipation / Diagnose probable faecal impaction in constipation
rule_level_problems.problem: The '> 65 years' arm of the impaction trigger is dropped without a trace because the grammar has no numeric age. Not an encoding error, but a silent coverage gap that should be recorded as 'could not model'.

rule_level_problems.rule: Diagnose possible colorectal cancer in constipation
rule_level_problems.problem: 'Persistent' is dropped from 'persistent abdominal discomfort'; the rule raises possible colorectal cancer on any abdominal discomfort/colic/pain with constipation. A 'Chronic persistent' qualifier value exists. Minor over-trigger; the rule is only 'possible'.

The red-box items and the impaction-trigger items (bed-ridden, palliative, overflow) share one check_for list. They are separated by a blank line and all are consumed, so the tests pass, but a reader of the task name 'Check for urgent constipation conditions' would not expect impaction triggers there. Cosmetic.

summary: The red box is encoded fully and with sound concepts: Obstipation and Unable to break wind with onset >= 24 hours, abdominal pain or distension, Urgent. The biggest miss is the colorectal-cancer risk-factor criterion (personal history of colorectal cancer/polyps/IBD, family history of colorectal cancer/Lynch syndrome), which is absent although SNOMED covers every item; 'change in stool consistency' is also missing. The priority rule's AND between 'no stools' and 'no flatus' is a defensible literal reading but under-triggers relative to the house red-box pattern and should be a documented decision; the unrepresentable age thresholds (> 65 for impaction, > 50 for cancer risk) are dropped silently.
